description: A group of eight restaurants across three cities handles bookings today by phone and with a shared spreadsheet, and loses tables to no-shows and double bookings. It wants an online reservation system for all eight locations. Guests book from the website and from a mobile-friendly page, choosing the restaurant, date, time and party size. Each restaurant has its own floor plan, opening hours and capacity, and managers can block tables or whole evenings for private events. The system needs confirmation and reminder emails and SMS messages, and one-click cancellation or modification of a booking. To reduce no-shows, a credit card guarantee through Stripe will be required on Friday and Saturday evenings. Host stand staff need a simple tablet view with today's bookings, walk-ins and table status, and managers need a weekly report on occupancy, no-show rate and covers per restaurant. A GDPR-compliant customer database is required, with consent for marketing emails. Integration with the Square point of sale is left for later. The brand design only exists for the public website; the admin screens can be clean and functional. The guest-facing side must support English and French. Goal: first version live in 10-12 weeks, at least for three pilot restaurants. Open question: a waiting list for fully booked evenings.
